item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
As far as the writing itself goes, it strikes me as something that would appear in a real aid organization's literature. The piece conveys information in such a manner as to give the reader some good information about the organization in question, without it feeling like an artificial construct created solely for the purposes of exposition. So in that sense, I commend the work.

I cannot support it with an upvote, however, as I have serious thematic issues with the presence of materials like this on the wiki, that I have discussed at length elsewhere and won't bore anyone with here. Suffice to say it's a matter of personal taste.

On balance, neutral vote.

I like this. One issue, though:

Dr. Sarah "Opal" Desjeux is a thirty-eight years old Health and Prevention Field Executive member and has worked as such for thirty-two years, making her one of the most veteran field workers in the Manna Charitable Foundation. She worked as a volunteer for three years and has been a Mission Work Group Operation Leader for ten.

So, she has been working for MCF since she was six? Also , the first sentence makes it sound like she's been a field executive for all that time.
